scope: Offline long-only strict-R3 base-to-meta conversion ablation. It tests raw rich-policy net utility against the incumbent simple policy-residual consensus target, conditional on the B0 top-30% route, then tests bounded demotion/recovery overlays. No live, canonical, model-bundle, admission, portfolio, or execution contract changes are made.

commands: strict walk-forward run: 2025 Jul-Dec selection; 2026 Apr-Jul confirmation with mandatory B0 control and two 2025-selected challengers
target-free schema audit across 54 held prediction files: no policy outcome, label availability, residual target, or MC1 fields

causality: The route is B0 timestamp-local top-30%; direct-head scores are inputs only and never add route identities.
Every monthly meta model fits only the preceding three calendar months with labels resolved before the held month.
Held prediction files are target-free. Policy outcomes and frozen MC1 maps are joined only downstream for evaluation.
Demotion/recovery heads can only rerank B0-routed candidates and cannot create a dual-MC1 admission.
result_boundary: The 2025 Jul-Dec comparison selects two rich-policy target arms for 2026 confirmation. The demotion/recovery overlays did not advance. This is research evidence only; it is not a canonical or live promotion.
